nodes.title: Containments between time and space classes

nodes.summary: The complexity class NL is closed under complementation: a decision problem $L$ belongs to NL if and only if its complement, the decision problem that is true exactly on the bitstrings where $L$ is false, belongs to NL.
nodes.title: Immerman-Szelepcsenyi theorem: NL = coNL

nodes.summary: If every decision problem in NP belongs to P/poly (polynomial time with polynomial advice), then the polynomial hierarchy PH equals its second level $\Sigma_2^p$.
nodes.title: Karp-Lipton theorem: NP in P/poly collapses PH

nodes.summary: If P $\ne$ NP, then there is a decision problem $L$ in NP that is not in P and to which not every decision problem in NP reduces by a polynomial-time many-one reduction; that is, $L$ is in NP but is neither in P nor NP-complete.
nodes.title: Ladner's theorem: NP-intermediate languages exist
Polynomial time in a cost-annotated programming model

nodes.summary: The complexity class NPSPACE of decision problems decided in polynomial space by nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machines equals the class PSPACE of decision problems decided in polynomial space by deterministic multi-tape Turing machines.
nodes.title: Savitch's theorem: NPSPACE = PSPACE
The classes P, NP and coNP
Time- and resource-bounded runs of abstract machines
Time and space classes on multi-tape machines

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
